text:
marta: quick sync from today's prototype run — threshold field confusion popped again. users couldn't tell whether they were entering percent or counts while actively typing.

evelyn: same observation. one tester typed 80 and immediately checked preview; preview showed 80 requests and they thought percent didn't apply.

sam: can you share steps to repro? i'll triage the component.

marta: repro: edit SLO > focus threshold > type `80` fast > toggle metric selector between 'pct' and 'count' > unit label disappears until blur and preview sometimes uses route default metric. chrome + mac.

ashwin: sounds like a render race where unit display relies on blur-triggered state. backend stores pct as fraction (0-1), frontend currently sends raw numbers.

evelyn: design proposal: show a faint trailing unit inside the input while focused (visual only) and include a brief helper line underneath: "e.g., 95% or 1000 requests".

sam: implementation note: we should accept `95`, `95%`, and `0.95` and normalize client-side to fractional form for the API. i'll add tests.

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: visual-only unit must also be present in the accessible name. Use `aria-describedby` referencing hidden unit text, and use `role="status"` for validation errors to ensure screen readers announce them.

kai: small copy nit: instead of "Threshold" maybe "Alert threshold" with the helper beneath. keeps label concise but clearer.

marta: agree. microcopy draft: "Enter a threshold (e.g., 95% or 1000 requests)." Thoughts?

evelyn: that reads well in tests. concrete examples help reduce mistakes.

sam: i'll implement parser: strip `%`, coerce to number, if metric is pct and value > 1 then divide by 100 for API. also fix preview to prefer explicit SLO metric over route defaults.

ashwin: add telemetry keys `slo_threshold_normalized` and `slo_preview_metric_mismatch` so we can monitor if users keep hitting the mismatch.

a11y-bot: Contrast check: ensure helper text color meets AA for small text (>=4.5:1). if not, increase size or darken color.

marta: action items for design: 1) inline unit visible on focus, 2) helper text with example, 3) label -> "Alert threshold", 4) a11y notes (aria-describedby + role=status + contrast), 5) update Figma slices. i'll post link later.

evelyn: awesome. ping when Figma is up, i'll choose final copy.

sam: thanks 97 will queue PR after spec.

marta: end thread — will share Figma and PR link here.
